newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's O/N rates edge up to 21.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's O/N rates edge up to 21.25 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates edged up to 0.125 percent in balanced trade on Thursday, dealers said.
The overnight rates traded between 21.00 and 21.375 percent and closed at 21.25 percent, up from 21.125 percent on Wednesday.
Traders added that overnight rates would probably hover around current levels unless the central bank cuts its repo rates.
"Many players are banking on a repo rate cut," said Laszlo Egyed of West-LB Hungaria.
The National Bank of Hungary cut its repo rates by 0.25 percentage points each on April 26.
The benchmark one-week reverse repo rate stands at 20.75 percent.
